## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: Tokenizer used for measurement is named and pinned (e.g., tiktoken cl100k_base as documented proxy); same tokenizer for both pre and post counts

## Description
Add `Tokenizer` abstraction inside scratch-measure-token-reduction.py selecting tokenizer named in config (default tiktoken:cl100k_base as documented Anthropic-token proxy; char/4 fallback if tiktoken unavailable, documented). Tokenizer name recorded for report. Single-construction guarantee for same tokenizer across pre/post.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Tokenizer.count deterministic for same input
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
- [ ] Unknown tokenizer name rejected
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
- [ ] Tokenizer name exposed and matches config
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
